task: Add one shared model-value validation rule and apply it in the codemie-claude launcher and a new request-level hook on the local proxy's Claude path, with a shared test-value table and unit tests for both.

key_reasoning.reason: Four components: a shared validator in src/utils (shared by agents core and proxy plugin), a Claude-only branch in AgentCLI.handleRun, a new handleRequest interceptor in the SSO proxy plugins registered in plugins/index.ts, and the shared test-value table. Spans Core, Plugin and Utils.

Closest patterns are the --reasoning-effort launch check and gateway-key.plugin (Anthropic envelope, handleRequest). Neither covers model-value input validation or leak-free messages (AC4), so this is a divergence and a security-sensitive input-validation gap. Edge-case AC (tab, NBSP, empty, non-text) also has no existing shared parameterized table. Hazards: empty is treated as absent in four places, env vs config.model under --profile, hook priority against client attribution and desktop alias rewriting, and the exact Unicode whitespace/control set.

About 3 modified files (AgentCLI.ts, plugins/index.ts, possibly plugin-order test) and 5-6 new files (validator, proxy plugin, shared test table, validator, launcher and plugin test files). Spread over src/utils, src/agents/core and src/providers/.../proxy/plugins.
